title: LibScript Declarative Operating System Specification
description: Declarative configuration schema defining target operating systems, unikernels, microVM appliances, and kernel images.

schema_version.description: Semantic schema version identifier for this specification format (e.g. 1.0.0)

profile_name.description: Human-readable identifier or compilation profile name

description.description: Detailed description of the target operating system appliance or profile

target.description: Architecture, operating system family, and runtime target specifications

os_family.description: Operating system and kernel ecosystem family

submodel.description: Microarchitecture optimization flags passed to GCC/Clang (e.g. x86-64-v3, neoverse-n1)

kernel.description: Kernel source provider, configuration fragments, and command line parameters

provider.description: Kernel distribution and source branch provider

fragments.description: List of modular kernel configuration fragment names merged during build

items.description: Kernel configuration fragment filename or identifier

cmdline.description: Default kernel command line parameters string appended at boot

init_system.description: PID 1 init system supervisor and service management configuration

default_target.description: Default boot runlevel or systemd target unit

services_enabled.description: List of service names enabled on startup

display.description: Display server and window compositing subsystems

compositor.description: Wayland compositor or X11 window manager

desktop.description: Graphical desktop environment suites and greeter display managers

desktop_suite.description: Full desktop application suite and shell integration

storage.description: Disk image geometry, partition table layout, and bootloader specifications

disk_size_gib.description: Total virtual disk capacity allocated in gigabytes

bootloader.description: Bootloader binary and EFI payload implementation

uki.description: Whether to build a signed Unified Kernel Image (.efi binary combining kernel, initramfs, and cmdline)

mountpoint.description: Mount point path in the target VFS tree

size_mib.description: Partition size in megabytes (0 represents remaining disk space)

enabled.description: Enables LUKS2 encryption for this partition volume

pbkdf.description: Password-based key derivation function algorithm (e.g. argon2id)

users.description: Initial user account accounts provisioned in target system

shell.description: Default interactive user shell executable path

password_hash.description: Encrypted password hash string (e.g. SHA-512 or yescrypt format)

locale.description: System locale, keymap, and timezone settings

lang.description: Default POSIX locale language identifier (e.g. en_US.UTF-8, C.UTF-8)

keymap.description: Console keyboard keymap layout identifier (e.g. us, de, fr)

timezone.description: Olson timezone database identifier (e.g. UTC, America/New_York)

network.description: Host network stack and initial interface configuration

dhcp.description: Enable automatic DHCP address resolution on primary interface

dns_servers.description: List of default upstream DNS resolver IP addresses

offline.description: Air-gapped execution and pre-hydrated cache controls

enabled.description: Strictly enforce zero network connectivity during image synthesis

cache_dir.description: Filesystem path pointing to pre-fetched offline package cache repository

packages.description: List of additional LibScript package recipes or components to install
